dct_description_sm:
Web mapping application offering hourly weather updates provided by Manitoba Agriculture.

The Manitoba Agriculture Weather Program (MAWP) operates more than 100 weather stations that provide regularly updated air temperature, relative humidity, precipitation, wind speed, wind direction, soil temperature, soil moisture, and barometric pressure.  Disclaimer: Manitoba Agriculture Weather Program reports data in 15 minute, hourly, and daily intervals, however, values may change due to corrections, calibrations, or disruptions from equipment malfunction. Data displayed has undergone minimal quality control. MAWP provides data “as is” and disclaims any and all warranties, whether expressed or implied. Under no circumstance will MAWP be liable for any direct or indirect, incidental, consequential, special or exemplary damages resulting from any use or misuse of the data or products and services derived from the data. For enquiries, please email agriculture@gov.mb.ca.
